name: Lorazepam
description: Lorazepam (Ativan) facts: uses for anxiety, insomnia and seizures, dosing basics, risks, interactions, overdose, withdrawal, and legal access.
quick: Lorazepam (Ativan) is an intermediate-acting benzodiazepine used for anxiety, short-term insomnia caused by anxiety, and, by injection, for status epilepticus and sedation before procedures. It is a Schedule IV controlled substance.
facts: Anxiety; insomnia due to anxiety; status epilepticus and pre-procedure sedation (injection)
Tablets, extended-release capsules, oral concentrate, injection
Use with opioids; misuse and addiction; dependence and withdrawal

blocks.p: Lorazepam tablets are approved for anxiety disorders and short-term relief of anxiety, including anxiety with depression. Injected lorazepam is a first-line treatment for status epilepticus and is used for sedation before surgery.[[1]]
Because lorazepam is cleared by glucuronidation rather than CYP liver enzymes, it has fewer drug interactions and is often preferred in older adults and people with liver disease.

The figures below come from the FDA-approved label and describe how prescribers typically use lorazepam. They are not personal dosing advice. A prescriber sets the dose for each person and adjusts it over time.[[1]]

head: Use
Typical adult dose
Label guidance
rows: 2 to 3 mg a day in 2 or 3 doses
1 to 2 mg a day in divided doses

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of lorazepam?

boxed.title: FDA boxed warnings
items: Taking benzodiazepines with opioids can cause profound sedation, slowed breathing, coma, and death.[[2]]
Benzodiazepines can be misused and can lead to addiction, which raises the risk of overdose and death.[[3]]
Regular use can cause physical dependence. Stopping suddenly or cutting the dose quickly can cause withdrawal reactions, including seizures, that can be life-threatening.[[3]]

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include sedation, dizziness, weakness, and unsteadiness. Memory problems for events after a dose can occur.[[1]]

sections.q: What does lorazepam overdose look like?

blocks.p: Lorazepam overdose causes drowsiness, confusion, lethargy, poor coordination, low blood pressure, and coma. Combined with opioids or alcohol, breathing can stop.[[1]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse lorazepam, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

sections.q: What is lorazepam withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: People who take lorazepam regularly, even as prescribed, can become physically dependent within weeks. With an intermediate half-life, withdrawal typically begins within a day or two of the last dose.[[3]]

timeline.title: Symptoms begin
timeline.text: Rebound anxiety, insomnia, restlessness, sweating, and tremor.

timeline.title: Acute withdrawal
timeline.text: Panic, irritability, muscle pain, nausea, sensitivity to light and sound, and in severe cases seizures or delirium.

timeline.title: Protracted symptoms in some people
timeline.text: A minority have lingering anxiety, poor sleep, low mood, or tingling that can last weeks to more than 12 months.

blocks.warn: Stopping lorazepam abruptly after regular use can cause seizures. The dose should be reduced gradually under the care of a prescriber.

blocks.p: A gradual taper, sometimes after switching to a longer-acting benzodiazepine such as diazepam, reduces symptoms and the risk of seizures.[[4]]

sections.q: How do you get lorazepam legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, lorazepam is a Schedule IV controlled substance. The only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a clinician registered with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), filled by a licensed pharmacy. Depending on state law, that can be a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.[[5]]

ul: **Refills:** a Schedule IV prescription can be refilled up to five times within six months of the date it was written. After that, a new prescription is needed.[[6]]

**Telehealth:** federal flexibilities let DEA-registered clinicians prescribe Schedule II to V medicines after a telemedicine visit, without a prior in-person exam, through December 31, 2026. A permanent DEA rule was under final review in late 2026. State rules can be stricter.[[7]]
**Monitoring:** prescribers and pharmacists in most states check a prescription drug monitoring program, a database of controlled-substance prescriptions, before prescribing or dispensing.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[8]][[9]]

blocks.warn: Pills sold as Ativan outside a pharmacy are often counterfeit. The DEA reports that fake pills frequently contain fentanyl or methamphetamine, and they cannot be told apart by appearance.[[10]]

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill lorazepam prescriptions online and ship them. Buying lorazepam from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[8]][[10]]

steps: A clinician evaluates you in person or by telemedicine and decides whether lorazepam is appropriate.
The prescription goes to a pharmacy
Prescriptions for controlled medicines are usually sent electronically, straight from the prescriber to the pharmacy you choose.
The pharmacy checks and fills it
A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells lorazepam with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[8]][[9]]

faq: Roughly 1 mg of lorazepam equals about 0.5 mg of alprazolam. Lorazepam lasts somewhat longer.
Why is lorazepam used in hospitals?
It works quickly by injection, is a first-line treatment for prolonged seizures, and has few drug interactions.
How long does lorazepam stay in your system?
Its half-life is about 12 hours. Urine tests usually detect it for 3 to 6 days.
Is lorazepam safe for older adults?
It is preferred over some benzodiazepines because it does not build up, but all benzodiazepines raise the risk of falls, confusion, and fractures in older adults.
